article.title: Cleveland and Minnesota meet in non-conference showdown
article.linkText: Cleveland and Minnesota meet in non-conference showdown
article.story: Minnesota Timberwolves (2-0, fifth in the Western Conference) vs. Cleveland Cavaliers (1-1, ninth in the Eastern Conference) Cleveland; Monday, 7 p.m. EDT LINE: Cavaliers -3.5; over/under is 232.5 BOTTOM LINE: Cleveland takes on Minnesota in out-of-conference action. Cleveland went 52-30 overall with a 27-14 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Cavaliers averaged 8.5 steals, 5.0 blocks and 13.3 turnovers per game last season. Minnesota went 49-33 overall with a 23-18 record on the road last season. The Timberwolves allowed opponents to score 114.6 points per game and shoot 46.2% from the field last season. INJURIES: Cavaliers: Nae'Qwan Tomlin: out (back), Khalifa Diop: out (knee). Timberwolves: Donte DiVincenzo: out (achilles). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
